text: Our massive tax cuts provide tremendous relief for the middle class and small business.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: To lower tax rates for hardworking Americans, we nearly doubled the standard deduction for everyone.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Now, the first $24,000 earned by a married couple is completely tax-free.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We also doubled the child tax credit.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We also doubled the child tax credit.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: A typical family of four making $75,000 will see their tax bill reduced by $2,000, slashing their tax bill in half.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In April, this will be the last time you will ever file under the old and very broken system, and millions of Americans will have more take-home pay starting next month -- a lot more.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We eliminated an especially cruel tax that fell mostly on Americans making less than $50,000 a year, forcing them to pay tremendous penalties simply because they couldn't afford government-ordered health plans.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We repealed the core of the disastrous Obamacare.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The individual mandate is now gone.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank heaven.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We slashed the business tax rate from 35 percent all the way down to 21 percent, so American companies can compete and win against anyone else anywhere in the world.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: These changes alone are estimated to increase average family income by more than $4,000.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: A lot of money.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Small businesses have also received a massive tax cut, and can now deduct 20 percent of their business income.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Here tonight are Steve Staub and Sandy Keplinger of Staub Manufacturing, a small, beautiful business in Ohio.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: They've just finished the best year in their 20-year history.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Because of tax reform, they are handing out raises, hiring an additional 14 people, and expanding into the building next door.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Good feeling.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: One of Staub's employees, Corey Adams, is also with us tonight.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Corey is an all-American worker. He supported himself through high school, lost his job during the 2008 recession, and was later hired by Staub, where he trained to become a welder.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Like many hardworking Americans, Corey plans to invest his tax cut raise into his new home and his two daughters' education.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Corey, please stand.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And he's a great welder.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I was told that by the man that owns that company that's doing so well.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: So congratulations, Corey.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Since we passed tax cuts, roughly 3 million workers have already gotten tax cut bonuses -- many of them thousands and thousands of dollars per worker.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And it's getting more every month, every week.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Apple has just announced it plans to invest a total of $350 billion in America, and hire another 20,000 workers.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And just a little while ago, ExxonMobil announced a $50 billion investment in the United States, just a little while ago.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This, in fact, is our new American moment.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: There has never been a better time to start living the American Dream.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: So to every citizen watching at home tonight, no matter where you've been, or where you've come from, this is your time.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: If you work hard, if you believe in yourself, if you believe in America, then you can dream anything, you can be anything, and together, we can achieve absolutely anything.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Tonight, I want to talk about what kind of future we are going to have, and what kind of a nation we are going to be.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: All of us, together, as one team, one people, and one American family can do anything.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We all share the same home, the same heart, the same destiny, and the same great American flag.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Together, we are rediscovering the American way.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In America, we know that faith and family, not government and bureaucracy, are the center of American life.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The motto is, "In God We Trust."

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And we celebrate our police, our military, and our amazing veterans as heroes who deserve our total and unwavering support.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Here tonight is Preston Sharp, a 12-year-old boy from Redding, California, who noticed that veterans' graves were not marked with flags on Veterans Day.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He decided all by himself to change that, and started a movement that has now placed 40,000 flags at the graves of our great heroes.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Preston, a job well done.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Young patriots, like Preston, teach all of us about our civic duty as Americans.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And I met Preston a little while ago, and he is something very special -- that I can tell you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Great future.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you very much for all you've done, Preston.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you very much.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Preston's reverence for those who have served our nation reminds us of why we salute our flag, why we put our hands on our hearts for the Pledge of Allegiance, and why we proudly stand for the National Anthem.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Americans love their country, and they deserve a government that shows them the same love and loyalty in return.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: For the last year, we have sought to restore the bonds of trust between our citizens and their government.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Working with the Senate, we are appointing judges who will interpret the Constitution as written, including a great new Supreme Court justice, and more circuit court judges than any new administration in the history of our country.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We are totally defending our Second Amendment, and have taken historic actions to protect religious liberty.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And we are serving our brave veterans, including giving our veterans choice in their healthcare decisions.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Last year, Congress also passed, and I signed, the landmark VA Accountability Act.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Since its passage, my administration has already removed more than 1,500 VA employees who failed to give our veterans the care they deserve.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And we are hiring talented people who love our vets as much as we do.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And I will not stop until our veterans are properly taken care of, which has been my promise to them from the very beginning of this great journey.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: All Americans deserve accountability and respect, and that's what we are giving to our wonderful heroes, our veterans.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: So, tonight, I call on Congress to empower every Cabinet Secretary with the authority to reward good workers and to remove federal employees who undermine the public trust or fail the American people.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In our drive to make Washington accountable, we have eliminated more regulations in our first year than any administration in the history of our country.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We have ended the war on American energy, and we have ended the war on beautiful clean coal.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We are now very proudly an exporter of energy to the world.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In Detroit, I halted government mandates that crippled America's great, beautiful autoworkers so that we can get Motor City revving its engines again.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And that's what's happening.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Many car companies are now building and expanding plants in the United States -- something we haven't seen for decades.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Chrysler is moving a major plant from Mexico to Michigan.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Toyota and Mazda are opening up a plant in Alabama -- a big one.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And we haven't seen this in a long time.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: It's all coming back.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Very soon, auto plants and other plants will be opening up all over our country.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This is all news Americans are totally unaccustomed to hearing.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: For many years, companies and jobs were only leaving us.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: But now they are roaring back.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: They're coming back.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: They want to be where the action is.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: They want to be in the United States of America.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: That's where they want to be.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Exciting progress is happening every single day.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: To speed access to breakthrough cures and affordable generic drugs, last year the FDA approved more new and generic drugs and medical devices than ever before in our country's history.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We also believe that patients with terminal conditions, and terminal illness, should have access to experimental treatment immediately that could potentially save their lives.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: People who are terminally ill should not have to go from country to country to seek a cure.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I want to give them a chance right here at home.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: It's time for Congress to give these wonderful, incredible Americans the right to try.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: One of my greatest priorities is to reduce the price of prescription drugs.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In many other countries, these drugs cost far less than what we pay in the United States.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And it's very, very unfair.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: That is why I have directed my administration to make fixing the injustice of high drug prices one of my top priorities for the year.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And prices will come down substantially.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Watch.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: America has also finally turned the page on decades of unfair trade deals that sacrificed our prosperity and shipped away our companies, our jobs, and our wealth.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Our nation has lost its wealth, but we're getting it back so fast.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The era of economic surrender is totally over.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: From now on, we expect trading relationships to be fair and, very importantly, reciprocal.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We will work to fix bad trade deals and negotiate new ones.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And they'll be good ones, but they'll be fair.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And we will protect American workers and American intellectual property through strong enforcement of our trade rules.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: As we rebuild our industries, it is also time to rebuild our crumbling infrastructure.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: America is a nation of builders.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We built the Empire State Building in just one year.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Isn't it a disgrace that it can now take 10 years just to get a minor permit approved for the building of a simple road?

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I am asking both parties to come together to give us safe, fast, reliable, and modern infrastructure that our economy needs and our people deserve.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Tonight, I'm calling on Congress to produce a bill that generates at least $1.5 trillion for the new infrastructure investment that our country so desperately needs.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Every federal dollar should be leveraged by partnering with state and local governments and, where appropriate, tapping into private sector investment to permanently fix the infrastructure deficit.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And we can do it.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Any bill must also streamline the permitting and approval process, getting it down to no more than two years, and perhaps even one.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Together, we can reclaim our great building heritage.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We will build gleaming new roads, bridges, highways, railways, and waterways all across our land.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And we will do it with American heart, and American hands, and American grit.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We want every American to know the dignity of a hard day's work.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We want every child to be safe in their home at night.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And we want every citizen to be proud of this land that we all love so much.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We can lift our citizens from welfare to work, from dependence to independence, and from poverty to prosperity.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: As tax cuts create new jobs, let's invest in workforce development and let's invest in job training, which we need so badly.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Let's open great vocational schools so our future workers can learn a craft and realize their full potential.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And let's support working families by supporting paid family leave.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: As America regains its strength, opportunity must be extended to all citizens.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: That is why this year we will embark on reforming our prisons to help former inmates who have served their time get a second chance at life.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Struggling communities, especially immigrant communities, will also be helped by immigration policies that focus on the best interests of American workers and American families.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: For decades, open borders have allowed drugs and gangs to pour into our most vulnerable communities.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: They've allowed millions of low-wage workers to compete for jobs and wages against the poorest Americans.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Most tragically, they have caused the loss of many innocent lives.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Here tonight are two fathers and two mothers: Evelyn Rodriguez, Freddy Cuevas, Elizabeth Alvarado, and Robert Mickens.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Their two teenage daughters -- Kayla Cuevas and Nisa Mickens -- were close friends on Long Island.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: But in September 2016, on the eve of Nisa's 16th Birthday -- such a happy time it should have been -- neither of them came home.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: These two precious girls were brutally murdered while walking together in their hometown.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Six members of the savage MS-13 gang have been charged with Kayla and Nisa's murders.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Many of these gang members took advantage of glaring loopholes in our laws to enter the country as illegal, unaccompanied alien minors, and wound up in Kayla and Nisa's high school.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Evelyn, Elizabeth, Freddy, and Robert: Tonight, everyone in this chamber is praying for you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Everyone in America is grieving for you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Please stand.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you very much.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I want you to know that 320 million hearts are right now breaking for you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We love you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: While we cannot imagine the depths of that kind of sorrow, we can make sure that other families never have to endure this kind of pain.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Tonight, I am calling on Congress to finally close the deadly loopholes that have allowed MS-13, and other criminal gangs, to break into our country.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We have proposed new legislation that will fix our immigration laws and support our ICE and Border Patrol agents -- these are great people;

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: these are great, great people -- that work so hard in the midst of such danger so that this can never happen again.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The United States is a compassionate nation.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We are proud that we do more than any other country anywhere in the world to help the needy, the struggling, and the underprivileged all over the world.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: But as President of the United States, my highest loyalty, my greatest compassion, my constant concern is for America's children, America's struggling workers, and America's forgotten communities.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I want our youth to grow up to achieve great things.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I want our poor to have their chance to rise.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: So, tonight, I am extending an open hand to work with members of both parties, Democrats and Republicans, to protect our citizens of every background, color, religion, and creed.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: My duty, and the sacred duty of every elected official in this chamber, is to defend Americans, to protect their safety, their families, their communities, and their right to the American Dream.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Because Americans are dreamers too.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Here tonight is one leader in the effort to defend our country, Homeland Security Investigations Special Agent Celestino Martinez. He goes by "DJ" and "CJ."

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He said, "Call me either one."

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: So we'll call you "CJ."

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Served 15 years in the Air Force before becoming an ICE agent and spending the last 15 years fighting gang violence and getting dangerous criminals off of our streets.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Tough job.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: At one point, MS-13 leaders ordered CJ's murder.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And they wanted it to happen quickly.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: But he did not cave to threats or to fear.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Last May, he commanded an operation to track down gang members on Long Island.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: His team has arrested nearly 400, including more than 220 MS-13 gang members.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And I have to tell you, what the Border Patrol and ICE have done -- we have sent thousands and thousands and thousands of MS-13 horrible people out of this country or into our prisons.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: So I just want to congratulate you, CJ.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: You're a brave guy.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you very much.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And I asked CJ, "What's the secret?"

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He said, "We're just tougher than they are."

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And I like that answer.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Now let's get Congress to send you -- and all of the people in this great chamber have to do it;

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: we have no choice.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: CJ, we're going to send you reinforcements, and we're going to send them to you quickly.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: It's what you need.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Over the next few weeks, the House and Senate will be voting on an immigration reform package.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In recent months, my administration has met extensively with both Democrats and Republicans to craft a bipartisan approach to immigration reform.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Based on these discussions, we presented Congress with a detailed proposal that should be supported by both parties as a fair compromise, one where nobody gets everything they want, but where our country gets the critical reforms it needs and must have.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Here are the four pillars of our plan: The first pillar of our framework generously offers a path to citizenship for 1.8 million illegal immigrants who were brought here by their parents at a young age.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: That covers almost three times more people than the previous administration covered.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Under our plan, those who meet education and work requirements, and show good moral character, will be able to become full citizens of the United States over a 12-year period.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The second pillar fully secures the border.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: That means building a great wall on the southern border, and it means hiring more heroes, like CJ, to keep our communities safe.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Crucially, our plan closes the terrible loopholes exploited by criminals and terrorists to enter our country, and it finally ends the horrible and dangerous practice of catch and release.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The third pillar ends the visa lottery, a program that randomly hands out green cards without any regard for skill, merit, or the safety of American people.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: It's time to begin moving towards a merit-based immigration system, one that admits people who are skilled, who want to work, who will contribute to our society, and who will love and respect our country.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The fourth and final pillar protects the nuclear family by ending chain migration.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Under the current broken system, a single immigrant can bring in virtually unlimited numbers of distant relatives.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Under our plan, we focus on the immediate family by limiting sponsorships to spouses and minor children.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This vital reform is necessary, not just for our economy, but for our security and for the future of America.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In recent weeks, two terrorist attacks in New York were made possible by the visa lottery and chain migration.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In the age of terrorism, these programs present risks we can just no longer afford.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: It's time to reform these outdated immigration rules, and finally bring our immigration system into the 21st century.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: These four pillars represent a down-the-middle compromise, and one that will create a safe, modern, and lawful immigration system.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: For over 30 years, Washington has tried and failed to solve this problem.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This Congress can be the one that finally makes it happen.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Most importantly, these four pillars will produce legislation that fulfills my ironclad pledge to sign a bill that puts America first.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: So let's come together, set politics aside, and finally get the job done.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: These reforms will also support our response to the terrible crisis of opioid and drug addiction.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Never before has it been like it is now.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: It is terrible.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We have to do something about it.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In 2016, we lost 64,000 Americans to drug overdoses -- 174 deaths per day;

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: 7 per hour.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We must get much tougher on drug dealers and pushers if we are going to succeed in stopping this scourge.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: My administration is committed to fighting the drug epidemic and helping get treatment for those in need, for those who have been so terribly hurt.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The struggle will be long and it will be difficult, but as Americans always do -- in the end, we will succeed.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We will prevail.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: As we have seen tonight, the most difficult challenges bring out the best in America.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We see a vivid expression of this truth in the story of the Holets family of New Mexico.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Ryan Holets is 27 years old, an officer with the Albuquerque Police Department.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He's here tonight with his wife Rebecca.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you, Ryan.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Last year, Ryan was on duty when he saw a pregnant, homeless woman preparing to inject heroin.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: When Ryan told her she was going to harm her unborn child, she began to weep.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: She told him she didn't know where to turn, but badly wanted a safe home for her baby.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In that moment, Ryan said he felt God speak to him: "You will do it, because you can."

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He heard those words.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He took out a picture of his wife and their four kids.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Then, he went home to tell his wife Rebecca.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In an instant, she agreed to adopt.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The Holets named their new daughter Hope.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Ryan and Rebecca, you embody the goodness of our nation.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you, Ryan and Rebecca.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: As we rebuild America's strength and confidence at home, we are also restoring our strength and standing abroad.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Around the world, we face rogue regimes, terrorist groups, and rivals like China and Russia that challenge our interests, our economy, and our values.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In confronting these horrible dangers, we know that weakness is the surest path to conflict, and unmatched power is the surest means to our true and great defense.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: For this reason, I am asking Congress to end the dangerous defense sequester and fully fund our great military.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: As part of our defense, we must modernize and rebuild our nuclear arsenal, hopefully never having to use it, but making it so strong and so powerful that it will deter any acts of aggression by any other nation or anyone else.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Perhaps someday in the future, there will be a magical moment when the countries of the world will get together to eliminate their nuclear weapons.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Unfortunately, we are not there yet, sadly.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Last year, I also pledged that we would work with our allies to extinguish ISIS from the face of the Earth.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: One year later, I am proud to report that the coalition to defeat ISIS has liberated very close to 100 percent of the territory just recently held by these killers in Iraq and in Syria and in other locations, as well.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: But there is much more work to be done.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We will continue our fight until ISIS is defeated.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Army Staff Sergeant Justin Peck is here tonight.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Near Raqqa, last November, Justin and his comrade, Chief Petty Officer Kenton Stacy, were on a mission to clear buildings that ISIS had rigged with explosive so that civilians could return to that city hopefully soon, and hopefully safely.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Clearing the second floor of a vital hospital, Kenton Stacy was severely wounded by an explosion.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Immediately, Justin bounded into the booby-trapped and unbelievably dangerous and unsafe building, and found Kenton, but in very, very bad shape.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He applied pressure to the wound and inserted a tube to reopen an airway.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He then performed CPR for 20 straight minutes during the ground transport, and maintained artificial respiration through two and a half hours and through emergency surgery.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Kenton Stacy would have died if it were not for Justin's selfless love for his fellow warrior.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Tonight, Kenton is recovering in Texas.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Raqqa is liberated.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And Justin is wearing his new Bronze Star, with a "V" for "valor."

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Staff Sergeant Peck, all of America salutes you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Terrorists who do things like place bombs in civilian hospitals are evil.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: When possible, we have no choice but to annihilate them.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: When necessary, we must be able to detain and question them.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: But we must be clear: Terrorists are not merely criminals.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: They are unlawful enemy combatants.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And when captured overseas, they should be treated like the terrorists they are.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In the past, we have foolishly released hundreds and hundreds of dangerous terrorists, only to meet them again on the battlefield -- including the ISIS leader, al-Baghdadi, who we captured, who we had, who we released.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: So today, I'm keeping another promise.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I just signed, prior to walking in, an order directing Secretary Mattis, who is doing a great job, thank you -- (applause) -- to reexamine our military detention policy and to keep open the detention facilities in Guantanamo Bay.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I am asking Congress to ensure that, in the fight against ISIS and al Qaeda, we continue to have all necessary power to detain terrorists, wherever we chase them down, wherever we find them.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And in many cases, for them, it will now be Guantanamo Bay.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: At the same time, as of a few months ago, our warriors in Afghanistan have new rules of engagement.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Along with their heroic Afghan partners, our military is no longer undermined by artificial timelines, and we no longer tell our enemies our plans.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Last month, I also took an action endorsed unanimously by the U.S. Senate just months before.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I recognized Jerusalem as the capital of Israel.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Shortly afterwards, dozens of countries voted in the United Nations General Assembly against America's sovereign right to make this decision.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In 2016, American taxpayers generously sent those same countries more than $20 billion in aid.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: That is why, tonight, I am asking Congress to pass legislation to help ensure American foreign-assistance dollars always serve American interests, and only go to friends of America, not enemies of America.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: As we strengthen friendships all around the world, we are also restoring clarity about our adversaries.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: When the people of Iran rose up against the crimes of their corrupt dictatorship, I did not stay silent.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: America stands with the people of Iran in their courageous struggle for freedom.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I am asking Congress to address the fundamental flaws in the terrible Iran nuclear deal.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: My administration has also imposed tough sanctions on the communist and socialist dictatorships in Cuba and Venezuela.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: But no regime has oppressed its own citizens more totally or brutally than the cruel dictatorship in North Korea.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: North Korea's reckless pursuit of nuclear missiles could very soon threaten our homeland.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We are waging a campaign of maximum pressure to prevent that from ever happening.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Past experience has taught us that complacency and concessions only invite aggression and provocation.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I will not repeat the mistakes of past administrations that got us into this very dangerous position.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We need only look at the depraved character of the North Korean regime to understand the nature of the nuclear threat it could pose to America and to our allies.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Otto Warmbier was a hardworking student at the University of Virginia -- and a great student he was.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: On his way to study abroad in Asia, Otto joined a tour to North Korea.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: At its conclusion, this wonderful young man was arrested and charged with crimes against the state.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: After a shameful trial, the dictatorship sentenced Otto to 15 years of hard labor, before returning him to America last June, horribly injured and on the verge of death.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He passed away just days after his return.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Otto's wonderful parents, Fred and Cindy Warmbier, are here with us tonight, along with Otto's brother and sister, Austin and Greta.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Please.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Incredible people.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: You are powerful witnesses to a menace that threatens our world, and your strength truly inspires us all.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you very much.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Tonight, we pledge to honor Otto's memory with total American resolve.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Finally, we are joined by one more witness to the ominous nature of this regime.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: His name is Mr. Ji Seong-ho.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In 1996, Seong-ho was a starving boy in North Korea.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: One day, he tried to steal coal from a railroad car to barter for a few scraps of food, which were very hard to get.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In the process, he passed out on the train tracks, exhausted from hunger.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He woke up as a train ran over his limbs.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He then endured multiple amputations without anything to dull the pain or the hurt.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: His brother and sister gave what little food they had to help him recover and ate dirt themselves, permanently stunting their own growth.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Later, he was tortured by North Korean authorities after returning from a brief visit to China.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: His tormentors wanted to know if he'd met any Christians.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He had -- and he resolved, after that, to be free.

speaker: Donald J. Trump

text: To expand equal opportunity, I am also proud that we achieved record and permanent funding for our Nation's Historically Black Colleges and Universities.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: A good life for American families also requires the most affordable, innovative, and high-quality health care system on Earth.

text: Because of our powerful sanctions, the Iranian economy is doing very, very poorly.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We can help them make a very good and short-time recovery.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: It can all go very quickly, but perhaps they are too proud or too foolish to ask for that help.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We are here.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Let's see which road they choose.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: It is totally up to them.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: As we defend American lives, we are working to end America's wars in the Middle East.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: In Afghanistan, the determination and valor of our warfighters has allowed us to make tremendous progress, and peace talks are now underway.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I am not looking to kill hundreds of thousands of people in Afghanistan, many of them totally innocent.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: It is also not our function to serve other nations as law enforcement agencies.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: These are warfighters that we haveâthe best in the worldâand they either want to fight to win or not fight at all.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We are working to finally end America's longest war and bring our troops back home.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: War places a heavy burden on our Nation's extraordinary military families, especially spouses like Amy Williams from Fort Bragg, North Carolina, and her two children, 6-year-old Elliana and 3-year-old Rowan.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Amy works full-time and volunteers countless hours helping other military families.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: For the past 7 months, she has done it all while her husband, Sergeant First Class Townsend Williams, is in Afghanistan on his fourth deployment in the Middle East.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Amy's kids haven't seen their father's face in many months.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Amy, your family's sacrifice makes it possible for all of our families to live in safety and in peace, and we want to thank you.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you, Amy.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: But, Amy, there is one more thing.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Tonight we have a very special surprise.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I am thrilled to inform you that your husband is back from deployment.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: He is here with us tonight, and we couldn't keep him waiting any longer.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Welcome home, Sergeant Williams.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Thank you very much.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: As the world bears witness tonight, America is a land of heroes.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This is a place where greatness is born, where destinies are forged, and where legends come to life.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This is the home of Thomas Edison and Teddy Roosevelt, of many great generals including Washington, Pershing, Patton, and MacArthur.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This is the home of Abraham Lincoln, Frederick Douglass, Amelia Earhart, Harriet Tubman, the Wright Brothers, Neil Armstrong, and so many more.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This is the country where children learn names like Wyatt Earp, Davy Crockett, and Annie Oakley.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This is the place where the pilgrims landed at Plymouth and where Texas patriots made their last stand at the Alamoâ[applause]âthe beautiful, beautiful Alamo.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The American nation was carved out of the vast frontier by the toughest, strongest, fiercest, and most determined men and women ever to walk on the face of the Earth.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Our ancestors braved the unknown;

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: tamed the wilderness;

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: settled the Wild West;

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: lifted millions from poverty, disease, and hunger;

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: vanquished tyranny and fascism;

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: ushered the world to new heights of science and medicine;

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: laid down the railroads, dug out the canals, raised up the skyscrapers.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And, ladies and gentlemen, our ancestors built the most exceptional republic ever to exist in all of human history, and we are making it greater than ever before.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This is our glorious and magnificent inheritance.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We are Americans.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We are pioneers.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We are the pathfinders.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We settled the New World, we built the modern world, and we changed history forever by embracing the eternal truth that everyone is made equal by the hand of Almighty God.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: America is the place where anything can happen.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: America is the place where anyone can rise.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: And here, on this land, on this soil, on this continent, the most incredible dreams come true.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: This Nation is our canvas, and this country is our masterpiece.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: We look at tomorrow and see unlimited frontiers just waiting to be explored.

speaker: Donald J. Trump

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The American age, the American epic, the American adventure has only just begun.

speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Our spirit is still young, the Sun is still rising, God's grace is still shining, and, my fellow Americans, the best is yet to come.

text: Anyway, thank you all.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Madam Speaker, Madam Vice President, no President has ever said those words from this podium.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: No President has ever said those words, and it's about time.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: First Lady, I'm her husband;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Second Gentleman;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Chief Justice;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Members of the United States Congress and the Cabinet;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: distinguished guests;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: my fellow Americans: While the setting tonight is familiar, this gathering is just a little bit different, a reminder of the extraordinary times we're in.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Throughout our history, Presidents have come to this Chamber to speak to Congress, to the Nation, and to the world;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: to declare war, to celebrate peace;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: to announce new plans and possibilities.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Tonight I come to talk about crisis and opportunity, about rebuilding the Nation, revitalizing our democracy, and winning the future for America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I stand here tonight, 1 day shy of the hundredth day of my administration, hundred days since I took the oath of office and lifted my hand off our family Bible and inherited a Nation, we all did, that was in crisis: the worst pandemic in a century, the worst economic crisis since the Great Depression, the worst attack on our democracy since the Civil War.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Now, after just 100 days, I can report to the Nation: America is on the move again, turning peril into possibility, crisis to opportunity, setbacks into strength.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We all know life can knock us down.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But, in America, we never, ever, ever stay down.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Americans always get up.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Today, that's what we're doing: America is rising anew, choosing hope over fear, truth over lies, and light over darkness.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: After 100 days of rescue and renewal, America is ready for takeoff, in my view.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're working again, dreaming again, discovering again, and leading the world again.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have shown each other and the world that there's no quit in America, none.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One hundred days ago, America's house was on fire.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we had to act.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And thanks to the extraordinary leadership of Speaker Pelosi;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Majority Leader Schumer;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: and the overwhelming support of the American people, Democrats, Independents, and Republicans, we did act.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Together we passed the American Rescue Plan, one of the most consequential rescue packages in American history.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're already seeing the results.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're already seeing the results.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: After I promised we'd get 100 million COVID-19 vaccine shots into people's arms in 100 days, we will have provided over 220 million COVID shots in those 100 days.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Thanks to all the help of all of you, we're marshaling, with your help, everyone's help, we're marshaling every Federal resource.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We've gotten vaccines to nearly 40,000 pharmacies and over 700 community health centers where the poorest of the poor can be reached.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're setting up community vaccination sites, developing mobile units to get to hard-to-reach communities.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Today, 90 percent of Americans now live within 5 miles of a vaccination site.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Everyone over the age of 16, everyone, is now eligible to get vaccinated right now, right away.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Go get vaccinated, America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Go and get the vaccination.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They're available.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: You're eligible now.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When I was sworn in on January 20, less than 1 percent of the seniors in America were fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One hundred days later, 70 percent of seniors in America over 65 are protected, fully protected.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Senior deaths from COVID-19 are down 80 percent since January, down 80 percent, because of all of you.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And more than half of all the adults in America have gotten at least one shot.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: At a mass vaccination center in Glendale, Arizona, I asked the nurse, I said, "What's it like?"

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: She looked at me, and she said, "It's like every shot is giving a dose of hope," was her phrase.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A dose of hope.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A dose of hope for an educator in Florida who has a child suffering from an autoimmune disease, wrote to me, said she's worried that she was worrying about bringing the virus home.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: She said she then got vaccinated at a large site, in her car.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: She said she sat in her car, when she got vaccinated and just cried, cried out of joy and cried out of relief.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Parents seeing the smiles on their kids' faces, for those who are able to go back to school because the teachers and school bus drivers and cafeteria workers have been vaccinated.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Grandparents hugging their children and grandchildren instead of pressing hands against a window to say goodbye.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It means everything.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Those things mean everything.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: You know, there's still, you all know it;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: you know it better than any group of Americans, there's still more work to do to beat this virus.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We can't let our guard down.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But tonight I can say it: Because of you, the American people, our progress these past hundred days against one of the worst pandemics in history has been one of the greatest logistical achievements, logistical achievements, this country has ever seen.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: What else have we done in those first hundred days?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We kept our commitment, Democrats and Republicans, of sending $1,400 rescue checks to 85 percent of American households.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We've already sent more than 160 million checks out the door.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's making the difference.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: You all know it when you go home.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: For many people, it's making all the difference in the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The single mom in Texas who wrote to me, she said she couldn't work, but she said the relief check put food on the table and saved her and her son from eviction from their apartment.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A grandmother in Virginia who told me she immediately took her granddaughter to the eye doctor, something she said she put off for months because she didn't have the money.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One of the defining images, at least from my perspective, in this crisis has been cars lined up, cars lined up for miles.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And not people who just barely ever start those cars, nice cars lined up for miles, waiting for a box of food to be put in their trunk.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I don't know about you, but I didn't ever think I'd see that in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And all of this is through no fault of their own.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: No fault of their own, these people are in this position.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why the Rescue Plan is delivering food and nutrition assistance to millions of Americans facing hunger, and hunger is down sharply already.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're also providing rental assistance, you all know this, but the American people, I want to make sure they understand, keeping people from being evicted from their homes, providing loans to small businesses to reopen and keep their employees on the job.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: During these 100 days, an additional 800,000 Americans enrolled in the Affordable Care Act when I established the special signup period to do that, 800,000 in that period.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're making one of the largest one-time ever investments, ever, in improving health care for veterans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Critical investments to address the opioid crisis.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And, maybe most importantly, thanks to the American Rescue Plan, we're on track to cut child poverty in America in half this year.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And, in the process, while this was all going on, the economy created more than 1,300,000 new jobs in 100 days, more jobs in the first 100 days than any President on record.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The International Monetary Fund is now estimating our economy will grow at a rate of more than 6 percent this year.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That will be the fastest pace of economic growth in this country in nearly four decades.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: America is moving, moving forward, but we can't stop now.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're in competition with China and other countries to win the 21st century.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're at a great inflection point in history

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have to do more than just build back better, I mean, build back.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have to build back better.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have to compete more strenuously than we have.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Throughout our history, if you think about it, public investment in infrastructure has literally transformed America: our attitudes, as well as our opportunities.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The transcontinental railroad, the interstate highways united two oceans and brought a totally new age of progress to the United States of America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Universal public schools and college aid opened wide the doors of opportunity.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Scientific breakthroughs took us to the Moon, now we're on Mars, discovering vaccines, gave us the internet, and so much more.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: These are the investments we made together as one country, and investments that only the Government was in a position to make.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Time and again, they propel us into the future.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why I proposed the American Jobs Plan, a once-in-a-generation investment in America itself.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: This is the largest jobs plan since World War II.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It creates jobs to upgrade our transportation infrastructure;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: jobs modernizing our roads, bridges, highways;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: jobs building ports and airports, rail corridors, transit lines.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's clean water.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And, today, up to 10 million homes in America and more than 400,000 schools and childcare centers have pipes with lead in them, including in drinking water, a clear and present danger to our children's health.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The American Jobs Plan creates jobs replacing 100 percent of the Nation's lead pipes and service lines so every American can drink clean water.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And, in the process, it will create thousands and thousands of good-paying jobs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It creates jobs connecting every American with high-speed internet, including 35 percent of the rural America that still doesn't have it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: This is going to help our kids and our businesses succeed in the 21st-century economy.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I'm asking the Vice President to lead this effort, if she would.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Vice President Kamala D. Harris, of course.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: because I know it will get done.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It creates jobs, building a modern power grid.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Our grids are vulnerable to storms, hacks, catastrophic failures, with tragic results, as we saw in Texas and elsewhere during the winter storms.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The American Jobs Plan will create jobs that will lay thousands of miles of transmission lines needed to build a resilient and fully clean grid.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We can do that.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, the American Jobs Plan will help millions of people get back to their jobs and back to their careers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Two million women have dropped out of the workforce during this pandemic, 2 million, and too often because they couldn't get the care they needed to care for their child or care for an elderly parent who needs help.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Eight hundred thousand families are on a Medicare waiting list right now to get home care for their aging parent or loved one with a disability.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If you think it's not important, check out in your own district, Democrat or Republican.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Democrat or Republican voters, their great concern, almost as much as their children, is taking care of an elderly loved one who can't be left alone.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Medicaid contemplated it, but this plan is going to help those families and create jobs for our caregivers with better wages and better benefits, continuing a cycle of growth.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: For too long, we've failed to use the most important word when it comes to meeting the climate crisis: jobs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Jobs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Jobs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: For me, when I think "climate change," I think "jobs."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The American Jobs Plan will put engineers and construction workers to work building more energy-efficient buildings and homes;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: electrical workers, IBEW members, installing 500,000 charging stations along our highways so we can own the electric car market.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Farmers, farmers planting cover crops so they can reduce the carbon dioxide in the air and get paid for doing it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, but think about it: There is simply no reason why the blades for wind turbines can't be built in Pittsburgh instead of Beijing.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: No reason.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: None.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: No reason.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So, folks, there's no reason why American workers can't lead the world in the production of electric vehicles and batteries.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I mean, there is no reason.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have this capacity.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have the brightest, best trained people in the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The American Jobs Plan is going to create millions of good-paying jobs, jobs Americans can raise a family on, as my dad would then say, "with a little breathing room."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And all the investments in the American Jobs Plan will be guided by one principle: buy American.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Buy American.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I might note, parenthetically, that does not violate any trade agreement.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's been the law since the thirties: buy American.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: American tax dollars are going to be used to buy American products made in America to create American jobs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's the way it's supposed to be and it will be in this administration.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I made it clear to all my Cabinet people.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Their ability to give exemptions has been strenuously limited.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It will be American products.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Now I know some of you at home are wondering whether these jobs are for you.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So many of you, so many of the folks I grew up with, feel left behind, forgotten in an economy that's so rapidly changing it's frightening.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I want to speak directly to you.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Because if you think about it, that's what people are most worried about: "Can I fit in?"

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Independent experts estimate the American Jobs Plan will add millions of jobs and trillions of dollars to economic growth in the years to come.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It is an 8-year program.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: These are good-paying jobs that can't be outsourced.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Nearly 90 percent of the infrastructure jobs created in the American Jobs Plan do not require a college degree;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: 75 percent don't require an associate's degree.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The American Jobs Plan is a blue-collar blueprint to build America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's what it is.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And it recognizes something I've always said in this Chamber and the other.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Good guys and women on Wall Street, but Wall Street didn't build this country.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The middle class built the country, and unions built the middle class.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So that's why I'm calling on Congress to pass the Protect the Right to Organize Act, the PRO Act, and send it to my desk so we can support the right to unionize.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And by the way, while you're thinking about sending things to my desk, let's raise the minimum wage to $15.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: No one, no one working 40 hours a week, no one working 40 hours a week should live below the poverty line.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We need to ensure greater equity and opportunity for women.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And while we're doing this, let's get the Paycheck Fairness Act to my desk as well, equal pay.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's been much too long.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And if you're wondering whether it's too long, look behind me.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And finally, the American Jobs Plan will be the biggest increase in non defense research and development on record.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We will see more technological change, and some of you know more about this than I do, we'll see more technological change in the next 10 years than we saw in the last 50.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's how rapidly artificial intelligence and so much more is changing.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we're falling behind the competition with the rest of the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Decades ago, we used to invest 2 percent of our gross domestic product in America, 2 percent of our gross domestic product, in research and development.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Today, Mr. Secretary, that's less than 1 percent.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: China and other countries are closing in fast.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have to develop and dominate the products and technologies of the future: advanced batteries, biotechnology, computer chips, clean energy.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The Secretary of Defense can tell you, and those of you on, who work on national security issues know, the Defense Department has an agency called DARPA, the Defense Advanced Research Project Agency.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The people who set up before I came here, and that's been a long time ago, to develop breakthroughs that enhance our national security, that's their only job.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And it's a semiseparate agency;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: it's under the Defense Department.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's led to everything from the discovery of the internet to GPS and so much more that's enhanced our security.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The National Institute of Health, the NIH, I believe, should create a similar Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And that would, here's what it would do.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It would have a singular purpose: to develop breakthroughs to prevent, detect, and treat diseases like Alzheimer's, diabetes, and cancer.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'll still never forget when we passed the cancer proposal the last year I was Vice President, almost $9 million going to NIH.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And if you excuse the point of personal privilege, I'll never forget you standing, Mitch, and saying you'd name it after my deceased son.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It meant a lot.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But so many of us have deceased sons, daughters, and relatives who died of cancer.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I can think of no more worthy investment.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I know of nothing that is more bipartisan.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So let's end cancer as we know it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's within our power.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's within our power to do it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Investments in jobs and infrastructure, like the ones we're talking about, have often had bipartisan support in the past.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Vice President Harris and I met regularly in the Oval Office with Democrats and Republicans to discuss the Jobs Plan.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I applaud a group of Republican Senators who just put forward their own proposal.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So let's get to work.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I wanted to lay out, before the Congress, my plan before we got into the deep discussions.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'd like to meet with those who have ideas that are different, they think are better.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I welcome those ideas.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But the rest of the world is not waiting for us.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I just want to be clear: From my perspective, doing nothing is not an option.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, we can't be so busy competing with one another that we forget the competition that we have with the rest of the world to win the 21st century.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Secretary Blinken can tell you, I spent a lot of time with President Xi: traveled over 17,000 miles with him;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: spent, they tell me, over 24 hours in private discussions with him.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When he called to congratulate me, we had a 2-hour discussion.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He's deadly earnest about becoming the most significant, consequential nation in the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He and others, autocrats, think that democracy can't compete in the 21st century with autocracies because it takes too long to get consensus.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: To win that competition for the future, in my view, we also need to make a once-in-a-generation investment in our families and our children.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why I've introduced the American Families Plan tonight, which addresses four of the biggest challenges facing American families and, in turn, America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: First is access to a good education.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When this Nation made 12 years of public education universal in the last century, it made us the best educated, best prepared Nation in the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's, I believe, the overwhelming reason that propelled us to where we got in the 21st, in the 20th century.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But the world has caught up, or catching up.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They are not waiting.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I would say, parenthetically: If we were sitting down, put a bipartisan committee together and said, "Okay, we're going to decide what we do in terms of government providing for free education," I wonder whether we'd think, as we did in the 20th century, that 12 years is enough in the 21st century.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I doubt it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Twelve years is no longer enough today to compete with the rest of the world in the 21st century.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why my American Families Plan guarantees 4 additional years of public education for every person in America, starting as early as we can.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The great universities of this country have conducted studies over the last 10 years.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It shows that adding 2 years of universal high-quality preschool for every 3-year-old and 4-year-old, no matter what background they come from, it puts them in the position to be able to compete all the way through 12 years.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It increases exponentially their prospect of graduating and going on beyond graduation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The research shows when a young child goes to school, not daycare, they are far more likely to graduate from high school and go to college or something after high school.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When you add 2 years of free community college on top of that, you begin to change the dynamic.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We can do that.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we'll increase Pell Grants and invest in Historical Black Colleges and Universities, Tribal Colleges, Minority-Serving Institutions.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The reason is: They don't have the endowments, but their students are just as capable of learning about cybersecurity, just as capable of learning about metallurgy, all the things that are going on that provide those jobs of the future.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Jill is a community college professor who teaches today as First Lady.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: She's long said, if I've heard it once, I've heard it a thousand times: "Joe, any country that out educates us is going to outcompete us."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: She'll be deeply involved in leading this effort.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Thank you, Jill.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Second thing we need: American Families Plan will provide access to quality, affordable childcare.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We guarantee, and I'm proposing a legislation to guarantee that low- and middle-income families will pay no more than 7 percent of their income for high-quality care for children up to the age of 5.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The most hard-pressed working families won't have to spend a dime.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Third, the American Families Plan will finally provide up to 12 weeks of paid leave and medical leave, family and medical leave.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're one of the few industrial countries in the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: No one should have to choose between a job and paycheck or taking care of themselves and their loved ones, a parent, a spouse, or child.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And fourth, the American Family Plan puts directly into the pockets of millions of Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In March, we expanded a tax credit for every child in a family.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Up to $3,000 per child, if they're under 6 years of age, I mean, excuse me, under, over [under]* 6 years of age, and $3,600 for children over 6 years of age.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: With two parents, two kids, that's $7,200 in the pockets that's going to help to take care of your family.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And that will help more than 65 million children and help cut childcare [child]* poverty in half.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we can afford it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So we did that in the last piece of legislation we passed.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But let's extend that childcare tax credit at least through the end of 2025.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The American Rescue Plan lowered health care premiums for 9 million Americans who buy their coverage under the Affordable Care Act.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I know that's really popular on this side of the aisle.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But let's make that provision permanent so their premiums don't go back up.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In addition to my Families Plan, I'm going to work with Congress to address, this year, other critical priorities for American families.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The Affordable Care Act has been a lifeline for millions of Americans, protecting people with preexisting conditions, protecting women's health.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And the pandemic has demonstrated how badly, how badly, it's needed.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's lower deductibles for working families on the Affordable Care, in the Affordable Care Act.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And let's lower prescription drug costs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We know how to do this.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The last President had that as an objective.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We all know how outrageously expensive drugs are in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In fact, we pay the highest prescription drug prices of anywhere in the world right here in America, nearly three times, for the same drug, nearly three times what other countries pay.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have to change that, and we can.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's do what we've always talked about for all the years I was down here in this body, in Congress.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's give Medicare the power to save hundreds of billions of dollars by negotiating lower drug prescription prices.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And by the way, it won't just help people on Medicare, it will lower prescription drug costs for everyone.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And the money we save, which is billions of dollars, can go to strengthen the Affordable Care Act and expand Medicare coverage benefits without costing taxpayers an additional penny.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's within our power to do it;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: let's do it now.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We've talked about it long enough.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Democrats and Republicans, let's get it done this year.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: This is all about a simple premise: Health care should be a right and not a privilege in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So how do we pay for my Jobs and Family Plan?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I made it clear, we can do it without increasing the deficits.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's start with what I will not do: I will not impose any tax increase on people making less than $400,000.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's, but it's time for corporate America and the wealthiest 1 percent of Americans to just begin to pay their fair share.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Just their fair share.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Sometimes, I have arguments with my friends in the Democratic Party.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I think you should be able to become a billionaire and a millionaire, but pay your fair share.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A recent study shows that 55 of the nation's biggest corporations paid zero Federal tax last year.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Those 55 corporations made in excess of $40 billion in profit.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A lot of companies also evade taxes through tax havens in Switzerland and Bermuda and the Cayman Islands.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And they benefit from tax loopholes and deductions for offshoring jobs and shifting profits overseas.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's not right.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're going to reform corporate taxes so they pay their fair share and help pay for the public investments their businesses will benefit from as well.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we're going to reward work, not just wealth.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We take the top tax bracket for the wealthiest 1 percent of Americans, those making over $400,000 or more, back up to where it was when George W. Bush was President when he started: 39.6 percent.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's where it was when George W. was President.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're going to get rid of the loopholes that allow Americans who make more than a million dollars a year and pay a lower tax rate on their capital gains than Americans who receive a paycheck.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're only going to affect three-tenths of 1 percent of all Americans by that action, three-tenths of 1 percent.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And the IRS is going to crack down on millionaires and billionaires who cheat on their taxes.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's estimated to be billions of dollars by think tanks that are left, right, and center.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'm not looking to punish anybody.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But I will not add a tax burden, additional tax burden to the middle class in this country.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They're already paying enough.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I believe what I propose is fair, fiscally responsible, and it raises revenue to pay for the plans I have proposed and will create millions of jobs that will grow the economy and enhance our financial standing in the country.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When you hear someone say that they don't want to raise taxes on the wealthiest 1 percent or corporate America, ask them: ""Whose taxes you want to raise instead?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Whose are you going to cut?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, the big tax cut of 2017, remember, it was supposed to pay for itself, that was how it was sold, and generate vast economic growth.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Instead, it added $2 trillion to the deficit.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It was a huge windfall for corporate America and those at the very top.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Instead of using the tax saving to raise wages and invest in research and development, it poured billions of dollars into the pockets of CEOs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In fact, the pay gap between CEOs and their workers is now among the largest in history.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: According to one study, CEOs make 320 times what the average worker in their corporation makes.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It used to be in the, below a hundred.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The pandemic has only made things worse.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Twenty million Americans lost their job in the pandemic: working and middle class Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: At the same time, roughly 650 billionaires in America saw their net worth increase by more than $1 trillion, in the same exact period.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let me say it again: 650 people increased their wealth by more than $1 trillion during this pandemic.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And they're now worth more than $4 trillion.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My fellow Americans, trickle-down, trickle-down economics has never worked, and it's time to grow the economy from the bottom and the middle out.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: You know, there's a broad consensus of economists, left, right, center, and they agree what I'm proposing will help create millions of jobs and generate historic economic growth.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: These are among the highest value investments we can make as a Nation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I've often said: Our greatest strength is the power of our example, not just the example of our power.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In my conversations with world leaders, and I've spoken to over 38, 40 of them now, I've made it known, I've made it known, that America is back.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And you know what they say?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The comment that I hear most of all from them is they say: "We see America is back, but for how long?"

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My fellow Americans, we have to show not just that we're back, but that we're back to stay and that we aren't going to go it alone.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're going to do it by leading with our allies.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: No one nation can deal with all the crises of our time, from terrorism, to nuclear proliferation, mass migration, cybersecurity, climate change, as well as experiencing, what we're experiencing now with pandemics.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: There's no wall high enough to keep any virus out.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And our own vaccine supply, as it grows to meet our needs, and we're meeting them, will become an arsenal for vaccines for other countries, just as America was the arsenal of democracy for the world and, in consequence, influenced the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
