text: But every American will have access before that occurs, every American will have access to be fully covered by COVID-19 from the vaccines we have.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, the climate crisis is not our fight alone, it's a global fight.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The United States accounts, as all of you know, less than 15 percent of carbon emissions.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The rest of the world accounts for 85 percent.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why I kept my commitment to rejoin the Paris accord, because if we do everything perfectly, it's not going to ultimately matter.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I kept my commitment to convene a climate summit right here in America with all of the major economies of the world, China, Russia, India, the European Union, and I said I'd do it in my first hundred days.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I want to be very blunt about it: my attempt was to make sure that the world could see there was a consensus, that we are at an inflection point in history.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And consensus, the consensus is: If we act to save the planet, we can create millions of jobs and economic growth and opportunity to raise the standard of living to almost everyone around the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If you've watched any of it, and you were all busy;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'm sure you didn't have much time, that's what virtually every nation said, even the ones that aren't doing their fair share.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The investments I've proposed tonight also advance the foreign policy, in my view, that benefits the middle class.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That means making sure every nation plays by the same rules in the global economy, including China.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My discussions, in my discussions with President Xi, I told him, We welcome the competition.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're not looking for conflict.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But I made absolutely clear that we will defend America's interests across the board.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: America will stand up to unfair trade practices that undercut American workers and American industries, like subsidies from state, to state-owned operations and enterprises and the theft of American technology and intellectual property.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I also told President Xi that we'll maintain a strong military presence in the Indo-Pacific, just as we do with NATO in Europe, not to start a conflict, but to prevent one.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I told him what I've said to many world leaders: that America will not back away from our commitments, our commitment to human rights and fundamental freedoms and to our alliances.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I pointed out to him: No responsible American President could remain silent when basic human rights are being so blatantly violated.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: An American President has to represent the essence of what our country stands for.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: America is an idea, the most unique idea in history: We are created, all of us, equal.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's who we are, and we cannot walk away from that principle and, in fact, say we're dealing with the American idea.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: With regard to Russia, I know it concerns some of you, but I made very clear to Putin that we're not going to seek, excuse me, escalation, but their actions will have consequence if they turn out to be true.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And they turned out to be true, so I responded directly and proportionally to Russia's interference in our elections and the cyber attacks on our Government and our business.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They did both of these things, and I told them we would respond, and we have.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But we can also cooperate when it's in our mutual interest.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We did it when we extended the New START Treaty on nuclear arms, and we're working to do it on climate change.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But he understands we will respond.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: On Iran and North Korea, nuclear programs that present serious threats to American security and the security of the world, we're going to be working closely with our allies to address the threats posed by both of these countries through diplomacy, as well as stern deterrence.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And American leadership means ending the forever war in Afghanistan.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have, without hyperbole, the greatest fighting force in the history of the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'm the first President in 40 years who knows what it means to have a son serving in a war zone.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Today, we have service members serving in the same war zone as their parents did.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have service members in Afghanistan who were not yet born on 9/11.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The war in Afghanistan, as we remember the debates here, were never meant to be multigenerational undertakings of nation-building.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We went to Afghanistan to get terrorists, the terrorists who attacked us on 9/11, and we said we would follow Usama bin Laden to the gates of hell to do it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If you've been to the upper Kunar Valley, you've kind of seen the gates of hell.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we delivered justice to bin Laden.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We degraded the terrorist threat of Al Qaida in Afghanistan.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And after 20 years of value, valor and sacrifice, it's time to bring those troops home.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, even as we do, we will maintain an over-the-horizon capacity to suppress future threats to the homeland.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And make no mistake: In 20 years, terrorists has, terrorism has metastasized.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The threat has evolved way beyond Afghanistan.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And those of you in the intelligence committees, the foreign relations committee, the defense committees, you know well: We have to remain vigilant against the threats to the United States wherever they come from.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Al Qaida and ISIS are in Yemen, Syria, Somalia, other places in Africa, the Middle East, and beyond.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we won't ignore what our intelligence agencies have determined to be the most lethal terrorist threat to the homeland today: White supremacy is terrorism.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're not going to ignore that either.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My fellow Americans, look, we have to come together to heal the soul of this Nation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It was nearly a year ago, before her father's funeral, when I spoke with Gianna Floyd, George Floyd's young daughter.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: She's a little tyke, so I was kneeling down to talk to her so I could look her in the eye.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And she looked at me and she said, "My daddy changed the world."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Well, after the conviction of George Floyd's murderer, we can see how right she was if we have the courage to act as a Congress.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We've all seen the knee of injustice on the neck of Black Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Now is our opportunity to make some real progress.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The vast majority of men and women wearing the uniform and a badge serve our communities, and they serve them honorably.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I know them.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I know they want to help meet this moment as well.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My fellow Americans, we have to come together to rebuild trust between law enforcement and the people they serve, to root out systemic racism in our criminal justice system, and to enact police reform in George Floyd's name that passed the House already.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I know Republicans have their own ideas and are engaged in the very productive discussions with Democrats in the Senate.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We need to work together to find a consensus.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But let's get it done next month, by the first anniversary of George Floyd's death.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The country supports this reform, and Congress should act, should act.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have a giant opportunity to bend to the arc of the moral universe towards justice, real justice.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And with the plans outlined tonight, we have a real chance to root out systemic racism that plagues America and American lives in other ways;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: a chance to deliver real equity, good jobs, good schools, affordable housing, clean air, clean water, being able to generate wealth and pass it down two generations because you have an access to purchase a house.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Real opportunities in the lives of more Americans: Black, White, Latino, Asian Americans, Native Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, I also want to thank the United States Senate for voting 94 to 1 to pass the COVID-19 Hate Crimes Act to protect Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: You acted decisively.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And you can see on television the viciousness of the hate crimes we've seen over the past year, this past year and for too long.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I urge the House to do the same and send that legislation to my desk, which I will gladly, anxiously sign.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I also hope Congress can get to my desk the Equality Act to protect LGBTQ Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: To all transgender Americans watching at home, especially young people who are so brave, I want you to know your President has your back.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Another thing: Let's authorize the Violence Against Women Act, which has been law for 27 years.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Twenty-seven years ago, I wrote it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It will close the, the act that has to be authorized now will close the "boyfriend" loophole to keep guns out of the hands of abusers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The court order said: "This is an abuser."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: You can't own a gun.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's to close that loophole that existed.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: You know, it's estimated that 50 women are shot and killed by an intimate partner every month in America, 50 a month.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's pass it and save some lives.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I need not tell anyone this, but gun violence is becoming an epidemic in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The flag at the White House was still flying at half-mast for the 8 victims in the mass shooting in Georgia when 10 more lives were taken in a mass shooting in Colorado.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And, in the week in between those two events, 250 other Americans were shot dead in the streets of America, 250 shot dead.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I know how hard it is to make progress on this issue.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In the nineties, we passed universal background checks, a ban on assault weapons and high-capacity magazines that hold 100 rounds that can be fired off in seconds.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We beat the NRA.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Mass shootings and gun violence declined.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Check out the report over 10 years.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But in the early twenty, 2000s, the law expired, and we've seen daily bloodshed since.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'm not saying if the law continued, we wouldn't see bloodshed.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: More than 2 weeks ago in the Rose Garden, surrounded by some of the bravest people I know, the survivors and families who lost loved ones to gun violence, I laid out several of the Department of Justice actions that are being taken to impact on this epidemic.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One of them is banning so-called "ghost guns."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: These are homemade guns built from a kit that includes directions on how to finish the firearm.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The parts have no serial numbers, so they show up at crime scenes, and they can't be traced.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The buyers of these ghost gun kits aren't required to pass any background check.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Anyone, from a criminal or terrorist, could buy this kit and, within 30 minutes, have a weapon that's lethal.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But no more.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I will do everything in my power to protect the American people from this epidemic of gun violence, but it's time for Congress to act as well.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, I don't want to become confrontational, but we need more Senate Republicans to join the overwhelming majority of Democratic colleagues and close the loopholes requiring a background check on purchases of guns.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We need a ban on assault weapons and high-capacity magazines.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And don't tell me it can't be done.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We did it before, and it worked.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Talk to most responsible gun owners and hunters.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They'll tell you there's no possible justification for having 100 rounds in a weapon.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: What do you think: deer are wearing Kevlar vests?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: No, what they'll tell you that there are too many people today who are able to buy a gun, but shouldn't be able to buy a gun.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: These kinds of reasonable reforms have overwhelming support from the American people, including many gun owners.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The country supports reform and is, and Congress should act.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: This shouldn't be a red or blue issue.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And no amendment to the Constitution is absolute.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: You can't yell "Fire!" in a crowded theater.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: From the very beginning, there were certain guns, weapons, that could not be owned by Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Certain people could not own those weapons ever.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're not changing the Constitution;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: we're being reasonable.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I think this is not a Democrat or Republican issue, I think it's an American issue.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And here's what else we can do: Immigration has always been essential to America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's end our exhausting war over immigration.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: For more than 30 years, politicians have talked about immigration reform, and we've done nothing about it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's time to fix it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: On day one of my Presidency, I kept my commitment and sent a comprehensive immigration bill to the United States Congress.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If you believe we need to secure the border, pass it, because it has a lot of money for high-tech border security.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If you believe in a pathway to citizenship, pass it so over 11 million undocumented folks, the vast majority are here overstaying visas.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Pass it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We can actually, if you actually want to solve a problem, I've sent a bill to, so take a close look at it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have to, also have to get at the root problem of why people are fleeing, particularly to, to our southern border from Guatemala, Honduras, and El Salvador: the violence, the corruption, the gangs, and the political instability, hunger, hurricanes, earthquakes, natural disasters.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When I was President, my President, when I was Vice President, the President asked me to focus on providing the help needed to address the root causes of migration.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And it helped keep people in their own countries instead of being forced to leave.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The plan was working, but the last administration decided it was not worth it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'm restoring the program and asked Vice President Harris to lead our diplomatic effort to take care of this.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I have absolute confidence she'll get the job done.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Now, look, if you don't like my plan, let's at least pass what we all agree on.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Congress needs to pass legislation this year to finally secure protection for "dreamers," the young people who have only known America as their home.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And permanent protection for immigrants who are here on temporary protected status who came from countries beset by manmade and natural-made, violence and disaster.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: As well as a pathway to citizenship for farmworkers who put food on our tables.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, immigrants have done so much for America during this pandemic and throughout our history.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The country supports immigration reform.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We should act.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's argue over it, let's debate it, but let's act.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And if we truly want to restore the soul of America, we need to protect the sacred right to vote.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Most people, more people voted in the last Presidential election than any time in American history, in the middle of the worst pandemic ever.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It should be celebrated.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Instead, it's being attacked.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Congress should pass H.R. 1 and the John Lewis Voting Rights Act and send it to my desk right away.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The country supports it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The Congress should act now.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, in closing, as we gather here tonight, the images of a violent mob assaulting this Capitol, desecrating our democracy, remain vivid in all our minds.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Lives were put at risk, many of your lives.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Lives were lost.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Extraordinary courage was summoned.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The insurrection was an existential crisis, a test of whether our democracy could survive.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And it did.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But the struggle is far from over.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The question of whether our democracy will long endure is both ancient and urgent, as old as our Republic, still vital today.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Can our democracy deliver on its promise that all of us, created equal in the image of God, have a chance to lead lives of dignity, respect, and possibility?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Can our democracy deliver the most, to the most pressing needs of our people?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Can our democracy overcome the lies, anger, hate, and fears that have pulled us apart?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: America's adversaries, the autocrats of the world, are betting we can't.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I promise you, they're betting we can't.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They believe we're too full of anger and division and rage.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They look at the images of the mob that assaulted the Capitol as proof that the sun is setting on American democracy.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But they are wrong.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: You know it;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I know it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But we have to prove them wrong.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have to prove democracy still works, that our Government still works and we can deliver for our people.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In our first hundred days together, we've acted to restore the people's faith in democracy to deliver.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're vaccinating the Nation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're creating hundreds of thousands of new jobs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're delivering real results to people;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: they can see it and feel it in their own lives.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Opening doors of opportunity, guaranteeing some more fairness and justice, that's the essence of America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's democracy in action.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Our Constitution opens with the words, as trite as it sounds, "We the People."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Well, it's time to remember that "We the People" are the Government, you and I.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Not some force in a distant capital.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Not some powerful force that we have no control over.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's us.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's "We the People."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In another era when our democracy was tested, Franklin Roosevelt reminded us, "In America, we do our part."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We all do our part.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's all I'm asking: that we do our part, all of us.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If we do that, we will meet the center challenge of the age by proving that democracy is durable and strong.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Autocrats will not win the future.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We will.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: America will.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And the future belongs to America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: As I stand here tonight before you, in a new and vital hour of life and democracy of our Nation, and I can say with absolute confidence: I have never been more confident or optimistic about America, not because I'm President, because what's happening with the American people.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have stared into the abyss of insurrection and autocracy, pandemic and pain, and "We the People" did not flinch.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: At the very moment our adversaries were certain we would pull apart and fail, we came together.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We united.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: With light and hope, we summoned a new strength, new resolve to position us to win the competition of the 21st century, on our way to a union more perfect, more prosperous, and more just, as one people, one Nation, and one America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Folks, as I told every world leader I've ever met with over the years, it's never ever, ever been a good bet to bet against America, and it still isn't.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We are the United States of America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: There is not a single thing, nothing, nothing beyond our capacity.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We can do whatever we set our mind to do if we do it together.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So let's begin to get together.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: God bless you all, and may God protect our troops.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Thank you for your patience.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Madam Speaker, Madam Vice President and our first lady and second gentleman.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Members of Congress and the cabinet.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Justices of the Supreme Court.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My fellow Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Last year, Covid-19 kept us apart.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: This year, we are finally together again.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Tonight, we meet as Democrats, Republicans and Independents.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But most importantly, as Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: With a duty to one another, to America, to the American people, to the Constitution.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And an unwavering resolve that freedom will always triumph over tyranny.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Six days ago, Russia's Vladimir Putin sought to shake the very foundations of the free world, thinking he could make it bend to his menacing ways.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But he badly miscalculated.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He thought he could roll into Ukraine, and the world would roll over.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Instead, he met a wall of strength he never anticipated or imagined.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He met the Ukrainian people.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: From President Zelensky to every Ukrainian, their fearlessness, their courage, their determination, literally inspires the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Groups of citizens blocking tanks with their bodies.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Everyone from students to retirees to teachers turned soldiers defending their homeland.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In this struggle, as President Zelensky said in his speech to the European Parliament, "light will win over darkness".

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The Ukrainian ambassador to The United States is here tonight, sitting with The first lady.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let each of us here, if you're able to stand, stand and send an unmistakable signal to the world and Ukraine.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Yes, we, the United States of America, stand with the Ukrainian people.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Throughout our history we've learned this lesson: When dictators do not pay a price for their aggression, they cause more chaos.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They keep moving.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And the costs and the threats to America and to the world keep rising.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why the NATO alliance was created: to secure peace and stability in Europe after World War II.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The United States is a member, along with 29 other nations.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It matters.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: American diplomacy matters.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: American resolve matters.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Putin's latest attack on Ukraine was premeditated and totally unprovoked.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He rejected repeated, repeated efforts at diplomacy.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He thought the West and NATO wouldn't respond.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He thought he could divide us at home, in this chamber and in this nation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He thought he could divide us in Europe as well.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But Putin was wrong.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We are ready.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We are united, and that's what we did.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We stayed united.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We prepared extensively and carefully.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We spent months building a coalition of other freedom-loving nations in Europe and the Americas to the Asian and African continents to confront Putin.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Like many of you, I spent countless hours unifying our European allies.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We shared with the world in advance what we knew Putin was planning, and precisely how he would try to falsify and justify his aggression.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We countered Russia's lies with the truth.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And now that he has acted, the free world is holding him accountable.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Along with 27 members of the European Union, including France, Germany, Italy, as well as countries like the United Kingdom, Canada, Japan, Korea, Australia, New Zealand and many others - even Switzerland - are inflicting pain on Russia and supporting the people of Ukraine.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Putin is now isolated from the world more than he has ever been.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Together, along with our allies, we are right now enforcing powerful economic sanctions.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We are cutting off Russia's largest banks from the international financial system, preventing Russia's central bank from defending the Russian ruble, making Putin's $630 billion war fund worthless.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We are choking Russia's access to technology that will sap its economic strength and weaken its military for years to come.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Tonight, I say to the Russian oligarchs and the corrupt leaders who have bilked billions of dollars off this violent regime: no more.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The United States Department of Justice is assembling a dedicated task force to go after the crimes of the Russian oligarchs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We are joining with European allies to find and seize their yachts, their luxury apartments, their private jets.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We are coming for your ill-begotten gains.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And tonight, I am announcing that we will join our allies in closing off American airspace to all Russian flights, further isolating Russia and adding an additional squeeze on their economy.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He has no idea what's coming.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The ruble has already lost 30 percent of its value.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The Russian stock market has lost 40 percent of its value, and trading remains suspended.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The Russian economy is reeling, and Putin alone is the one to blame.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Together with our allies, we are providing support to the Ukrainians in their fight for freedom.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Military assistance.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Economic assistance.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Humanitarian assistance.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We are giving more than $1 billion in direct assistance to Ukraine, and will continue to aid the Ukrainian people as they defend their country and help ease their suffering.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But let me be clear: Our forces are not engaged and will not engage in the conflict with Russian forces in Ukraine.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Our forces are not going to Europe to fight in Ukraine, but to defend our NATO allies in the event that Putin decides to keep moving west.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: For that purpose, we've mobilized American ground forces, air squadrons, ship deployments to protect NATO countries, including Poland, Romania, Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And as I have made crystal clear: The United States and our allies will defend every inch of territory that is NATO territory with the full force of our collective power.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Every single inch.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we're cleareyed.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The Ukrainians are fighting back with pure courage.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But the next few days, weeks and months will be hard on them.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Putin has unleashed violence and chaos.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But while he may make gains on the battlefield, he will pay a continuing high price over the long run.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And a proud, proud people, pound-for-pound ready to fight with every inch of energy they have - they have known 30 years of independence, have repeatedly shown that they will not tolerate anyone who tries to take their country backwards.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: To all Americans, I will be honest with you, as I always promised I would be.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A Russian dictator, invading a foreign country, has costs around the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I'm taking robust action to make sure the pain of our sanctions is targeted at Russian economy.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I will use every tool at our disposal to protect American businesses and consumers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Tonight, I can announce that the United States has worked with 30 other countries to release 60 million barrels of oil from reserves around the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: America will lead that effort, releasing 30 million barrels from our own Strategic Petroleum Reserve.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we stand ready to do more if necessary, unified with our allies.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: These steps will help blunt gas prices here at home.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But I know the news about what's happening can seem alarming to all Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But I want you to know that we are going to be OK.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We are going to be OK.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When the history of this era is written, Putin's war on Ukraine will have left Russia weaker and the rest of the world stronger.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: While it shouldn't have taken something so terrible for people around the world to see what's at stake, now everyone sees it clearly.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We see the unity among leaders of nations, a more unified Europe, a more unified West.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We see unity among the people who are gathering in cities, in large crowds around the world - even in Russia - to demonstrate their support for the people of Ukraine.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In the battle between democracy and autocracies, democracies are rising to the moment, and the world is clearly choosing the side of peace and security.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: This is the real test.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's going to take time.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So let us continue to draw inspiration from the iron will of the Ukrainian people.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: To our fellow Ukrainian Americans, who forged a deep bond that connects our two nations.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We stand with you.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We stand with you.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Putin may circle Kyiv with tanks, but he'll never gain the hearts and souls of the Iranian people.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He'll never extinguish their love of freedom.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And he will never, never weaken the resolve of the free world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We meet tonight in an America that has lived through two of the hardest years this nation has ever faced.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The pandemic has been punishing.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And so many families are living paycheck to paycheck, struggling to keep up with the rising cost of food, gas, housing and so much more.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I understand like many of you did.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My dad had to leave his home in Scranton, Pa., to find work.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So like many of you, I grew up in a family when the price of food went up, it was felt throughout the family.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It had an impact.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why one of the first things I did as president was fight to pass the American Rescue Plan.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Because people were hurting.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We needed to act, and we did.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Few pieces of legislation have done more at a critical moment in our history to lift us out of crisis.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It fueled our efforts to vaccinate the nation and combat Covid-19.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It delivered immediate economic relief to tens of millions of Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It helped put food on the table - remember those long lines of cars waiting for hours just to get a box of food put in their trunk.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It cut the cost of health insurance.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And as my dad used to say, it gave the people just a little breathing room.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Unlike the $2 trillion tax cut passed in the previous administration that benefited the top 1 percent of Americans, the American Rescue Plan helped working people - and left no one behind.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And it worked.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It created jobs - lots of jobs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In fact, our economy created over 6.5 million new jobs just last year, more jobs created in one year than ever before in the history of the United States of America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The economy grew at a rate of 5.7 last year, the strongest growth rate in nearly 40 years, the first step in bringing fundamental change to our economy that hasn't worked for the working people of this nation for too long.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: For the past 40 years, we were told that tax breaks for those at the top and benefits would trickle down, and everyone would benefit.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But that trickle-down theory led to a weaker economic growth, lower wages, bigger deficits and a widening gap between those at the top and everyone else in nearly a century.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, Vice President Harris and I ran for office - and I realized we had fundamental disagreements on this - but ran for office with a new economic vision for America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Invest in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Educate Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Grow the work force.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Build the economy from the bottom up and the middle out, not from the top down.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Because we know that when the middle class grows, the poor have a ladder up, and the wealthy do very well.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: America used to have the best roads, bridges and airports on earth.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Now our infrastructure is ranked 13th in the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We won't be able to compete for the jobs of the 21st century if we don't fix it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why it was so important to pass the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law - and I thank my Republican colleagues who joined to invest and rebuild America, the single biggest investment in history.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: This was a bipartisan effort, and I want to thank the members of both parties who worked to make it happen.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're done talking about infrastructure weeks.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're now talking about an infrastructure decade.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It is going to transform America, to put us on a path to win the economic competition of the 21st century that we face with the rest of the world - particularly China.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I've told Xi Jinping, it is never a good bet to bet against the American people.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We'll create good jobs for millions of Americans, modernizing roads, airports, ports, waterways all across America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we'll do it all to withstand the devastating effects of climate change and promote environmental justice.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We'll build a national network of 500,000 electric vehicle charging stations, begin to replace the poisonous lead pipes, so every child - every American - has clean water to drink at home and at school.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're going to provide affordable high-speed internet for every American- rural, urban, suburban and tribal communities.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Four thousand projects have already been announced.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Many of you have announced them in your districts.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And tonight, I'm announcing that this year we will start fixing over 65,000 miles of highway and 1,500 bridges in disrepair.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When we use taxpayers' dollars to rebuild America, we are going to do it by buying American: buy American products, support American jobs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The federal government spends about $600 billion a year to keep this country safe and secure.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: There's been a law on the books for almost a century to make sure taxpayers' dollars support American jobs and businesses.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Every administration, Democrat and Republican, says they'll do it, but we are actually doing it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We will buy American to make sure everything from the deck of an aircraft carrier to the steel on highway guardrails is made in America from beginning to end.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: All of it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: All of it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But folks, to compete for the jobs of the future, we also need to level the playing field with China and other competitors.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why it is so important to pass the Bipartisan Innovation Act sitting in Congress that will make record investments in emerging technologies and American manufacturing.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We used to invest 2 percent of our G.D.P.  in research and development.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We don't now.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: China is.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let me give you one example of why it's so important to pass it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If you travel 20 miles east of Columbus, Ohio, you'll find 1,000 empty acres of land.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It won't look like much, but if you stop and look closely, you'll see a field of dreams, the ground on which America's future will be built.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's where Intel, the American company that helped build Silicon Valley, is going to build its $20 billion semiconductor mega site.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Up to eight state-of-the-art factories in one place.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Ten thousand new jobs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In those factories, the average job: about $135,000 a year.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Some of the most sophisticated manufacturing in the world to make computer chips the size of a fingertip that power the world and everyday lives.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: From smartphones.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The internet.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Technology we have yet to invent.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But that's just the beginning.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Intel's C.E.O., Pat Gelsinger, who is here tonight - Pat told me they are ready to increase their investment from $20 billion to $100 billion.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That would be the biggest investment in manufacturing in American history.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And all they're waiting for is for you to pass this bill.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So let's not wait any longer.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Send it to my desk.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'll sign it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we will really take off in a big way.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And folks, Intel is not alone.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: There's something happening in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Just look around, and you'll see an amazing story.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The rebirth of pride that comes from stamping products "Made in America."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The revitalization of American manufacturing.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Companies are choosing to build new factories here, when just a few years ago, they would have gone overseas.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's what is happening.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Ford is investing $11 billion in electric vehicles, creating 11,000 jobs across the country.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: G.M. is making the largest investment in its history: $7 billion to build electric vehicles, creating 4,000 jobs in Michigan.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: All told, 369,000 new manufacturing jobs in America last year alone.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Powered by people I've met like JoJo Burgess, from generations of union steelworkers from Pittsburgh, who's here with us tonight.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: As Ohio Senator Sherrod Brown says, "It's time to bury the label 'Rust Belt.'"

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's time to see what used to be called the Rust Belt become the home of significant resurgence of manufacturing.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But with all the bright spots in our economy, record job growth, higher wages, too many families are struggling to keep up with the bills.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Inflation is robbing them of the gains they thought otherwise they would be able to feel.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I get it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why my top priority is getting prices under control.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, our economy roared back faster than almost anyone predicted, but the pandemic meant that businesses had a hard time hiring enough workers to keep up production in their factories.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So you didn't have people making those beams that went into buildings because they were out, the factory was closed.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The panic also disrupted the global supply chain.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Factories close.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When that happens, it takes longer to make goods and get them to the warehouses, to the stores, and prices go up.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look at cars last year.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One-third of all of the inflation was because of automobile sales.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: There weren't enough semiconductors to make all the cars that people wanted to buy.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And guess what, prices of automobiles went way up.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Especially used vehicles as well.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So, we have a choice.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One way to fight inflation is to drive down wages and make Americans poorer.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I think I have a better idea to fight inflation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Lower your costs, not your wages.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That means make more cars and semiconductors in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: More infrastructure and innovation in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: More goods moving faster and cheaper in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: More jobs where you can earn a good living in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And instead of relying on foreign supply chains, let's make it in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Economists call it "increasing the productive capacity of our economy."

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I call it building a better America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My plan to fight inflation will lower your costs and lower the deficit.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Seventeen Nobel laureates in economics said my plan will ease long-term inflationary pressures.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Top business leaders and I believe most Americans support my plan.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And here's the plan: First, cut the cost of prescription drugs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We pay more for the same drug produced by the same company in America than any other country in the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Just look at insulin.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One in 10 Americans has diabetes.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In Virginia, I met a 13-year-old boy, the handsome young man up there, Joshua Davis.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He and his dad both have Type 1 diabetes, which means they need insulin every single day.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Insulin costs about $10 a vial to make.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's what it costs the pharmaceutical company.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But drug companies charge families like Joshua and his dad up to 30 times that amount.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I spoke with Joshua's mom.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Imagine what it's like to look at your child who needs insulin to stay healthy and have no idea how in God's name you're going to be able to pay for it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: What it does to your family, but what it does to your dignity, your ability to look your child in the eye, to be the parent you expect yourself to be.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I really mean that, think about that.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's what I think about.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: You know, yesterday, Joshua is here tonight, but yesterday was his birthday.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Happy birthday, buddy, by the way.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: For Joshua, and for the 200,000 other young people with Type 1 diabetes, let's cap the cost of insulin at $35 a month so everyone can afford it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And drug companies will do very, very well - their profit margins.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And while we're at it, let's let Medicare negotiate the price of prescription drugs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They already set the price for V.A. drugs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Look, the American Rescue Plan is helping millions of families on Affordable Care Act plans to save them $2,400 a year on their health care premiums.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's close the coverage gap and make these savings permanent.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Second - cut energy costs for families an average of $500 a year by combating climate change.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's provide investments and tax credits to weatherize your homes and businesses to be energy efficient and you get a tax credit;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: double America's clean energy production in solar, wind, and so much more;

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: lower the price of electric vehicles, saving you another $80 a month because you'll never have to pay at the gas pump again.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Third - cut the cost of child care.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Many families pay up to $14,000 a year for child care per child.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Middle-class and working families shouldn't have to pay more than 7% of their income for care of young children.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My plan will cut the cost in half for most families and help parents, including millions of women, who left the work force during the pandemic because they couldn't afford child care, to be able to get back to work.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My plan doesn't stop there.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It also includes home and long-term care.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: More affordable housing.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And pre-K for every 3- and 4-year-old.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: All of these will lower costs.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And under my plan, nobody earning less than $400,000 a year will pay an additional penny in new taxes.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Nobody.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The one thing all Americans agree on is that the tax system is not fair.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have to fix it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'm not looking to punish anyone.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But let's make sure corporations and the wealthiest Americans start paying their fair share.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Just last year, 55 Fortune 500 corporations earned $40 billion in profits and paid zero dollars in federal income tax.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's simply not fair.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why I've proposed a 15% minimum tax rate for corporations.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We got more than 130 countries to agree on a global minimum tax rate so companies can't get out of paying their taxes at home by shipping jobs and factories overseas.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why I've proposed closing loopholes so the very wealthy don't pay a lower tax rate than a teacher or a firefighter.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So that's my plan.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It will grow the economy and lower costs for families.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So what are we waiting for?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's get this done.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And while you're at it, confirm my nominees to the Federal Reserve, which plays a critical role in fighting inflation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My plan will not only lower costs to give families a fair shot, it will lower the deficit.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The previous Administration not only ballooned the deficit with tax cuts for the very wealthy and corporations, it undermined the watchdogs whose job was to keep pandemic relief funds from being wasted.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But in my administration, the watchdogs have been welcomed back.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're going after the criminals who stole billions in relief money meant for small businesses and millions of Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And tonight, I'm announcing that the Justice Department will name a chief prosecutor for pandemic fraud.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: By the end of this year, the deficit will be down to less than half what it was before I took office.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The only president ever to cut the deficit by more than one trillion dollars in a single year.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Lowering your costs also means demanding more competition.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'm a capitalist, but capitalism without competition isn't capitalism.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's exploitation - and it drives up prices.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When corporations don't have to compete, their profits go up, your prices go up, and small businesses and family farmers and ranchers go under.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We see it happening with ocean carriers moving goods in and out of America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: During the pandemic, these foreign-owned companies raised prices by as much as 1,000% and made record profits.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Tonight, I'm announcing a crackdown on these companies overcharging American businesses and consumers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And as Wall Street firms take over more nursing homes, quality in those homes has gone down and costs have gone up.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That ends on my watch.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Medicare is going to set higher standards for nursing homes and make sure your loved ones get the care they deserve and expect.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We'll also cut costs and keep the economy going strong by giving workers a fair shot, provide more training and apprenticeships, hire them based on their skills not degrees.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's pass the Paycheck Fairness Act and paid leave.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Raise the minimum wage to $15 an hour and extend the Child Tax Credit, so no one has to raise a family in poverty.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's increase Pell Grants and increase our historic support of HBCUs, and invest in what Jill - our first lady who teaches full-time-calls America's best-kept secret: community colleges.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And let's pass the PRO Act when a majority of workers want to form a union - they shouldn't be stopped.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When we invest in our workers, when we build the economy from the bottom up and the middle out together, we can do something we haven't done in a long time: build a better America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: For more than two years, COVID-19 has impacted every decision in our lives and the life of the nation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I know you're tired, frustrated, and exhausted.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But I also know this.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Because of the progress we've made, because of your resilience and the tools we have, tonight I can say

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: we are moving forward safely, back to more normal routines.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We've reached a new moment in the fight against COVID-19, with severe cases down to a level not seen since last July.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Just a few days ago, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention - the CDC-issued new mask guidelines.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Under these new guidelines, most Americans in most of the country can now be mask free.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And based on the projections, more of the country will reach that point across the next couple of weeks.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Thanks to the progress we have made this past year, COVID-19 need no longer control our lives.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I know some are talking about -Ãºliving with COVID-19.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: #NAME?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We will continue to combat the virus as we do other diseases.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And because this is a virus that mutates and spreads, we will stay on guard.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Here are four common sense steps as we move forward safely.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: First, stay protected with vaccines and treatments.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We know how incredibly effective vaccines are.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If you're vaccinated and boosted you have the highest degree of protection.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We will never give up on vaccinating more Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Now, I know parents with kids under 5 are eager to see a vaccine authorized for their children.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The scientists are working hard to get that done and we'll be ready with plenty of vaccines when they do.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're also ready with anti-viral treatments.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If you get COVID-19, the Pfizer pill reduces your chances of ending up in the hospital by 90%.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We've ordered more of these pills than anyone in the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And Pfizer is working overtime to get us 1 Million pills this month and more than double that next month.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we're launching the "Test to Treat" initiative so people can get tested at a pharmacy, and if they're positive, receive antiviral pills on the spot at no cost.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If you're immunocompromised or have some other vulnerability, we have treatments and free high-quality masks.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're leaving no one behind or ignoring anyone's needs as we move forward.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And on testing, we have made hundreds of millions of tests available for you to order for free.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Even if you already ordered free tests tonight, I am announcing that you can order more from covidtests.gov starting next week.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Second - we must prepare for new variants.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Over the past year, we've gotten much better at detecting new variants.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If necessary, we'll be able to deploy new vaccines within 100 days instead of many more months or years.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And, if Congress provides the funds we need, we'll have new stockpiles of tests, masks, and pills ready if needed.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I cannot promise a new variant won't come.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But I can promise you we'll do everything within our power to be ready if it does.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Third - we can end the shutdown of schools and businesses.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have the tools we need.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's time for Americans to get back to work and fill our great downtowns again.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: People working from home can feel safe to begin to return to the office.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're doing that here in the federal government.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The vast majority of federal workers will once again work in person.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Our schools are open.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's keep it that way.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Our kids need to be in school.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And with 75% of adult Americans fully vaccinated and hospitalizations down by 77%, most Americans can remove their masks, return to work, stay in the classroom, and move forward safely.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We achieved this because we provided free vaccines, treatments, tests, and masks.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Of course, continuing this costs money.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I will soon send Congress a request.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The vast majority of Americans have used these tools and may want to again, so I expect Congress to pass it quickly.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Fourth, we will continue vaccinating the world.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We've sent 475 Million vaccine doses to 112 countries, more than any other nation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we won't stop.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We have lost so much to COVID-19.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Time with one another.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And worst of all, so much loss of life.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's use this moment to reset.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's stop looking at COVID-19 as a partisan dividing line and see it for what it is: A God-awful disease.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's stop seeing each other as enemies, and start seeing each other for who we really are: Fellow Americans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We can't change how divided we've been.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But we can change how we move forward - on COVID-19 and other issues we must face together.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I recently visited the New York City Police Department days after the funerals of Officer Wilbert Mora and his partner, Officer Jason Rivera.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They were responding to a 9-1-1 call when a man shot and killed them with a stolen gun.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Officer Mora was 27 years old.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Officer Rivera was 22.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Both Dominican Americans who'd grown up on the same streets they later chose to patrol as police officers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I spoke with their families and told them that we are forever in debt for their sacrifice, and we will carry on their mission to restore the trust and safety every community deserves.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I've worked on these issues a long time.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I know what works: Investing in crime preventionand community police officers who'll walk the beat, who'll know the neighborhood, and who can restore trust and safety.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So let's not abandon our streets.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Or choose between safety and equal justice.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's come together to protect our communities, restore trust, and hold law enforcement accountable.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why the Justice Department required body cameras, banned chokeholds, and restricted no-knock warrants for its officers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why the American Rescue Plan provided $350 Billion that cities, states, and counties can use to hire more police and invest in proven strategies like community violence interruption - trusted messengers breaking the cycle of violence and trauma and giving young people hope.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We should all agree: The answer is not to Defund the police.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The answer is to FUND the police with the resources and training they need to protect our communities.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I ask Democrats and Republicans alike: Pass my budget and keep our neighborhoods safe.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I will keep doing everything in my power to crack down on gun trafficking and ghost guns you can buy online and make at home - they have no serial numbers and can't be traced.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I ask Congress to pass proven measures to reduce gun violence.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Pass universal background checks.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Why should anyone on a terrorist list be able to purchase a weapon?

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Ban assault weapons and high-capacity magazines.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Repeal the liability shield that makes gun manufacturers the only industry in America that can't be sued.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: These laws don't infringe on the Second Amendment.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They save lives.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The most fundamental right in America is the right to vote - and to have it counted.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And it's under assault.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In state after state, new laws have been passed, not only to suppress the vote, but to subvert entire elections.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We cannot let this happen.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Tonight.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I call on the Senate to: Pass the Freedom to Vote Act.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And while you're at it, pass the Disclose Act so Americans can know who is funding our elections.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Tonight, I'd like to honor someone who has dedicated his life to serve this country: Justice Stephen Breyer - an Army veteran, Constitutional scholar, and retiring Justice of the United States Supreme Court.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Justice Breyer, thank you for your service.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One of the most serious constitutional responsibilities a President has is nominating someone to serve on the United States Supreme Court.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And I did that 4 days ago, when I nominated Circuit Court of Appeals Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One of our nation's top legal minds, who will continue Justice Breyer's legacy of excellence.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A former top litigator in private practice.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A former federal public defender.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And from a family of public school educators and police officers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A consensus builder.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Since she's been nominated, she's received a broad range of support - from the Fraternal Order of Police to former judges appointed by Democrats and Republicans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And if we are to advance liberty and justice, we need to secure the Border and fix the immigration system.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We can do both.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: At our border, we've installed new technology like cutting-edge scanners to better detect drug smuggling.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We've set up joint patrols with Mexico and Guatemala to catch more human traffickers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're putting in place dedicated immigration judges so families fleeing persecution and violence can have their cases heard faster.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We're securing commitments and supporting partners in South and Central America to host more refugees and secure their own borders.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We can do all this while keeping lit the torch of liberty that has led generations of immigrants to this land - my forefathers and so many of yours.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Provide a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers, those on temporary status, farm workers, and essential workers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Revise our laws so businesses have the workers they need and families don't wait decades to reunite.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's not only the right thing to do - it's the economically smart thing to do.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: That's why immigration reform is supported by everyone from labor unions to religious leaders to the U.S.  Chamber of Commerce.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Let's get it done once and for all.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Advancing liberty and justice also requires protecting the rights of women.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The constitutional right affirmed in Roe v. Wade - standing precedent for half a century-is under attack as never before.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If we want to go forward - not backward-we must protect access to health care.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Preserve a woman's right to choose.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And let's continue to advance maternal health care in America.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And for our LGBTQ+ Americans, let's finally get the bipartisan Equality Act to my desk.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The onslaught of state laws targeting transgender Americans and their families is wrong.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: As I said last year, especially to our younger transgender Americans, I will always have your back as your President, so you can be yourself and reach your God-given potential.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: While it often appears that we never agree, that isn't true.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I signed 80 bipartisan bills into law last year.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: From preventing government shutdowns to protecting Asian Americans from still-too-common hate crimes to reforming military justice.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And soon, we'll strengthen the Violence Against Women Act that I first wrote three decades ago.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It is important for us to show the nation that we can come together and do big things.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: So tonight I'm offering a Unity Agenda for the Nation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Four big things we can do together.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: First, beat the opioid epidemic.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: There is so much we can do.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Increase funding for prevention, treatment, harm reduction, and recovery.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Get rid of outdated rules that stop doctors from prescribing treatments.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And stop the flow of illicit drugs by working with state and local law enforcement to go after traffickers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: If you're suffering from addiction, know you are not alone.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I believe in recovery, and I celebrate the 23 million Americans in recovery.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Second, let's take on mental health.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Especially among our children, whose lives and education have been turned upside down.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The American Rescue Plan gave schools money to hire teachers and help students make up for lost learning.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I urge every parent to make sure your school does just that.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And we can all play a part - sign up to be a tutor or a mentor.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Children were also struggling before the pandemic.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Bullying, violence, trauma, and the harms of social media.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: As Frances Haugen, who is here with us tonight, has shown, we must hold social media platforms accountable for the national experiment they're conducting on our children for profit.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's time to strengthen privacy protections, ban targeted advertising to children, demand tech companies stop collecting personal data on our children.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And let's get all Americans the mental health services they need.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: More people they can turn to for help, and full parity between physical and mental health care.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Third, support our veterans.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Veterans are the best of us.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I've always believed that we have a sacred obligation to equip all those we send to war and care for them and their families when they come home.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My administration is providing assistance with job training and housing, and now helping lower-income veterans get VA care debt-free.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Our troops in Iraq and Afghanistan faced many dangers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One was stationed at bases and breathing in toxic smoke from "burn pits"Ã¹ that incinerated wastes of war - medical and hazard material, jet fuel, and more.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: When they came home, many of the world's fittest and best trained warriors were never the same.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Headaches.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Numbness.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Dizziness.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A cancer that would put them in a flag-draped coffin.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I know.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: One of those soldiers was my son Major Beau Biden.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We don't know for sure if a burn pit was the cause of his brain cancer, or the diseases of so many of our troops.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But I'm committed to finding out everything we can.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Committed to military families like Danielle Robinson from Ohio.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The widow of Sergeant First Class Heath Robinson.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He was born a soldier.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Army National Guard.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Combat medic in Kosovo and Iraq.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Stationed near Baghdad, just yards from burn pits the size of football fields.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Heath's widow Danielle is here with us tonight.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: They loved going to Ohio State football games.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He loved building Legos with their daughter.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: But cancer from prolonged exposure to burn pits ravaged Heath's lungs and body.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Danielle says Heath was a fighter to the very end.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: He didn't know how to stop fighting, and neither did she.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Through her pain she found purpose to demand we do better.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Tonight, Danielle - we are.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: The VA is pioneering new ways of linking toxic exposures to diseases, already helping more veterans get benefits.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And tonight, I'm announcing we're expanding eligibility to veterans suffering from nine respiratory cancers.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: I'm also calling on Congress: pass a law to make sure veterans devastated by toxic exposures in Iraq and Afghanistan finally get the benefits and comprehensive health care they deserve.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: And fourth, let's end cancer as we know it.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: This is personal to me and Jill, to Kamala, and to so many of you.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Cancer is the #2 cause of death in America - second only to heart disease.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Last month, I announced our plan to supercharge

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: the Cancer Moonshot that President Obama asked me to lead six years ago.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: Our goal is to cut the cancer death rate by at least 50% over the next 25 years, turn more cancers from death sentences into treatable diseases.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: More support for patients and families.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: To get there, I call on Congress to fund ARPA-H, the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: It's based on DARPA - the Defense Department project that led to the Internet, GPS, and so much more.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: ARPA-H will have a singular purpose - to drive breakthroughs in cancer, Alzheimer's, diabetes, and more.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: A unity agenda for the nation.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: We can do this.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: My fellow Americans - tonight, we have gathered in a sacred space-the citadel of our democracy.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
text: In this Capitol, generation after generation, Americans have debated great questions amid great strife, and have done great things.

speaker: Joseph R. Biden
